Post-graduation buyers (257) outnumber the bundle-heavy curve, and top-5 buyer concentration after graduation is 30%, which is moderate. Net flow over the last 15 minutes is positive (+22 SOL), and the sell-to-buy ratio of 0.76 in the first two minutes is not a dump signature.

But the case is weak. The curve shows bundle_share of 1.0 and top3_share of 0.86, meaning the early buying looks coordinated, and a completer_share above 1 is unusual. A launch bot was present. The 25% drawdown from the 30-minute high shows momentum is already rolling over, and the last-15-minute sell volume (743 SOL) nearly matches buys (765 SOL), so demand is being absorbed, not growing. With round-trip costs of 1.4-5.1% on a $20 ticket and a base rate of about -20% for coins in this age window, I cannot make a strong argument that demand will still be here in 30-60 minutes. My honest recommendation is to skip unless you have information outside this brief.
